items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: One time I was in San Francisco and Dizzy knocked on my hotel room door. I saw him down the street, and then a few minutes later Dizzy was at my door. He knocked on my door and came in, you know.

ctx.x: So I think they went to Fisk. So what I’m saying is that... I heard Willy Mitchell at Melrose, he had a big band. They was playing, like Dizzy’s big band.
